Name: Dungeon Infiltration & Sentry Patrol
Description: The fixed six-room capacity-gated dungeon: a sentry walks the outer loop while an infiltrator slips through the interior gates to the treasure vault. Both seats decide from their own two-hop perception filter, so the recording carries decision-time fog. The rooms and gates are fixed and the seed scales the treasury, which is why this is a seeded family rather than a hand-authored graph.
